title: Role Prompting
objectives: Explain the key ideas behind Role Prompting.

definition: Role Prompting is a core concept in Prompt Engineering. It refers to the techniques, principles and practices that let a practitioner work effectively with this topic in real systems.

theory.heading: What Role Prompting is
theory.body: Role Prompting describes the methods and patterns used within Prompt Engineering to achieve reliable, maintainable results. Understanding it is the foundation for everything built later in this course.
points: Role Prompting is a named, repeatable concept.
It has a clear purpose and scope.
It connects to other course topics.

theory.heading: Why Role Prompting matters
theory.body: Without Role Prompting, systems built with Prompt Engineering are harder to debug, extend and operate. Teams that master this topic ship fewer defects and communicate more clearly about design decisions.

theory.heading: How Role Prompting works
theory.body: The mechanism behind Role Prompting follows a repeatable sequence: understand the requirement, apply the principle, verify the result and refine based on feedback. Each step has checks that keep the work on track.
points: Apply the core principle of Role Prompting.

theory.heading: Advantages and limitations of Role Prompting
theory.body: Role Prompting offers structure, clarity and consistency, but it also adds overhead and may be overkill for trivial tasks. Use it when the benefit in reliability outweighs the added effort.
points: Limitations: added overhead, not always needed.
